import bpy
import math
from mathutils import Vector

# ---------- scene reset ----------
bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='SELECT')
bpy.ops.object.delete(use_global=False)
for c in list(bpy.data.collections):
    if c.name != "Collection":
        bpy.data.collections.remove(c)
bpy.data.collections.remove(bpy.data.collections["Collection"])

scene = bpy.context.scene
scene.render.engine = 'BLENDER_EEVEE_NEXT'
try:
    scene.eevee.use_raytracing = True
except Exception:
    pass
scene.render.resolution_x = 360
scene.render.resolution_y = 640
scene.render.resolution_percentage = 100
scene.render.fps = 30
scene.frame_start = 1
scene.frame_end = 420
scene.unit_settings.scale_length = 1.0
scene.render.image_settings.file_format = 'PNG'

# world
world = bpy.data.worlds.new("World")
scene.world = world
world.use_nodes = True
bg = world.node_tree.nodes["Background"]
bg.inputs[0].default_value = (0.13, 0.11, 0.085, 1.0)
bg.inputs[1].default_value = 1.0

# ---------- helpers ----------
def make_mat(name, color, rough=0.8, metallic=0.0, emission=None, estr=0.0):
    m = bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    m.use_nodes = True
    b = m.node_tree.nodes['Principled BSDF']
    b.inputs['Base Color'].default_value = (*color, 1.0)
    b.inputs['Roughness'].default_value = rough
    b.inputs['Metallic'].default_value = metallic
    if emission is not None:
        b.inputs['Emission Color'].default_value = (*emission, 1.0)
        b.inputs['Emission Strength'].default_value = estr
    return m

def make_coll(name):
    c = bpy.data.collections.new(name)
    scene.collection.children.link(c)
    return c

def link_to(obj, coll):
    for oc in list(obj.users_collection):
        oc.objects.unlink(obj)
    coll.objects.link(obj)

def finish(obj, name, mat, coll, smooth=False):
    obj.name = name
    if mat:
        obj.data.materials.append(mat)
    if smooth:
        for p in obj.data.polygons:
            p.use_smooth = True
    link_to(obj, coll)
    return obj

def cube(name, loc, dims, mat, coll, rot=(0, 0, 0)):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(location=loc, rotation=rot)
    o = bpy.context.active_object
    o.scale = (dims[0] / 2, dims[1] / 2, dims[2] / 2)
    return finish(o, name, mat, coll)

def cyl(name, loc, r, depth, mat, coll, rot=(0, 0, 0), smooth=True):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(radius=r, depth=depth, location=loc, rotation=rot)
    return finish(bpy.context.active_object, name, mat, coll, smooth)

def cyl_between(name, a, b, r, mat, coll):
    a, b = Vector(a), Vector(b)
    d = b - a
    mid = (a + b) / 2
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(radius=r, depth=d.length, location=mid)
    o = bpy.context.active_object
    o.rotation_mode = 'QUATERNION'
    o.rotation_quaternion = d.to_track_quat('Z', 'Y')
    return finish(o, name, mat, coll, True)

def cone(name, loc, r1, r2, depth, mat, coll, rot=(0, 0, 0), smooth=True):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cone_add(radius1=r1, radius2=r2, depth=depth, location=loc, rotation=rot)
    return finish(bpy.context.active_object, name, mat, coll, smooth)

def sphere(name, loc, r, mat, coll):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_uv_sphere_add(radius=r, location=loc, segments=16, ring_count=8)
    return finish(bpy.context.active_object, name, mat, coll, True)

def torus(name, loc, major, minor, mat, coll, rot=(0, 0, 0)):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_torus_add(major_radius=major, minor_radius=minor,
                                     major_segments=28, minor_segments=8,
                                     location=loc, rotation=rot)
    return finish(bpy.context.active_object, name, mat, coll, True)

# ---------- materials ----------
wall_mat   = make_mat("wall_cream", (0.78, 0.74, 0.64), 0.95)
floor_mat  = make_mat("floor_wood", (0.30, 0.155, 0.075), 0.6)
ceil_mat   = make_mat("ceiling", (0.88, 0.87, 0.84), 0.95)
teak       = make_mat("teak", (0.42, 0.20, 0.09), 0.45)
darkwood   = make_mat("darkwood", (0.16, 0.08, 0.04), 0.5)
bedspread  = make_mat("bedspread", (0.60, 0.56, 0.28), 0.95)
mattress_m = make_mat("mattress", (0.88, 0.86, 0.80), 0.95)
pillow_m   = make_mat("pillow_white", (0.90, 0.88, 0.82), 0.95)
cushion_m  = make_mat("cushion_cream", (0.80, 0.73, 0.58), 0.95)
orange     = make_mat("wheel_orange", (0.72, 0.27, 0.07), 0.55)
brass      = make_mat("brass", (0.55, 0.38, 0.14), 0.35, 0.85)
shade_m    = make_mat("lampshade", (0.82, 0.72, 0.55), 0.9)
leaf_m     = make_mat("leaf", (0.13, 0.30, 0.10), 0.7)
pot_m      = make_mat("pot_black", (0.03, 0.03, 0.03), 0.7)
mirror_m   = make_mat("mirror", (0.92, 0.94, 0.96), 0.03, 1.0)
white_m    = make_mat("trim_white", (0.90, 0.88, 0.82), 0.85)
curtain_m  = make_mat("curtain", (0.68, 0.54, 0.36), 0.95)
sill_m     = make_mat("sill", (0.48, 0.22, 0.10), 0.55)
glass_m    = make_mat("glass", (0.75, 0.82, 0.85), 0.08, 0.0)
outside_m  = make_mat("outside_glow", (0.55, 0.62, 0.38), 0.9, 0.0, (0.75, 0.82, 0.55), 2.0)
black_m    = make_mat("frame_black", (0.02, 0.02, 0.02), 0.6)
art_m      = make_mat("art_dark", (0.03, 0.05, 0.04), 0.8)
wicker     = make_mat("wicker", (0.42, 0.28, 0.13), 0.9)
green_m    = make_mat("panel_green", (0.80, 0.82, 0.68), 0.9)
metal_m    = make_mat("conduit", (0.75, 0.75, 0.73), 0.5, 0.6)

# ---------- room ----------
room = make_coll("Room")
cube("floor", (2.0, 2.25, -0.05), (4.0, 4.5, 0.1), floor_mat, room)
cube("ceiling", (2.0, 2.25, 2.90), (4.0, 4.5, 0.1), ceil_mat, room)
cube("wall_north", (2.0, 4.55, 1.45), (4.0, 0.1, 2.9), wall_mat, room)
cube("wall_south", (2.0, -0.05, 1.45), (4.0, 0.1, 2.9), wall_mat, room)
cube("wall_west", (-0.05, 2.25, 1.45), (0.1, 4.5, 2.9), wall_mat, room)
cube("wall_east", (4.05, 2.25, 1.45), (0.1, 4.5, 2.9), wall_mat, room)

# ---------- window (north wall, east of dresser) ----------
win = make_coll("Window")
wx0, wx1, wz0, wz1 = 3.05, 3.90, 0.95, 2.32
wcx, wcz = (wx0 + wx1) / 2, (wz0 + wz1) / 2
# glow plane outside
cube("outside_glow", (wcx, 4.95, wcz), (1.8, 0.02, 2.0), outside_m, win)
# glass
cube("window_glass", (wcx, 4.52, wcz), (wx1 - wx0 - 0.12, 0.02, wz1 - wz0 - 0.12), glass_m, win)
# frame
cube("win_frame_top", (wcx, 4.52, wz1 + 0.03), (wx1 - wx0 + 0.12, 0.14, 0.07), white_m, win)
cube("win_frame_bot", (wcx, 4.52, wz0 - 0.01), (wx1 - wx0 + 0.12, 0.14, 0.07), white_m, win)
cube("win_frame_l", (wx0 - 0.03, 4.52, wcz), (0.07, 0.14, wz1 - wz0 + 0.1), white_m, win)
cube("win_frame_r", (wx1 + 0.03, 4.52, wcz), (0.07, 0.14, wz1 - wz0 + 0.1), white_m, win)
# sash bars: mid horizontal + muntins
cube("win_sash_mid", (wcx, 4.51, wcz - 0.05), (wx1 - wx0 - 0.06, 0.05, 0.06), white_m, win)
for i, zz in enumerate([wz0 + (wz1 - wz0) * 0.28, wz0 + (wz1 - wz0) * 0.72]):
    cube("win_muntin_h%d" % i, (wcx, 4.515, zz), (wx1 - wx0 - 0.1, 0.02, 0.035), white_m, win)
for i, xx in enumerate([wx0 + (wx1 - wx0) / 3, wx0 + 2 * (wx1 - wx0) / 3]):
    cube("win_muntin_v%d" % i, (xx, 4.515, wcz), (0.035, 0.02, wz1 - wz0 - 0.1), white_m, win)
# sill (red wood)
cube("win_sill", (wcx, 4.46, wz0 - 0.05), (wx1 - wx0 + 0.2, 0.22, 0.045), sill_m, win)
# curtain rod + curtains
cyl("curtain_rod", (wcx, 4.42, 2.46), 0.014, 1.45, darkwood, win, rot=(0, math.pi / 2, 0))
cube("curtain_l", (wx0 - 0.13, 4.43, 1.68), (0.24, 0.09, 1.62), curtain_m, win, rot=(0, 0, 0.04))
cube("curtain_r", (wx1 + 0.12, 4.43, 1.68), (0.24, 0.09, 1.62), curtain_m, win, rot=(0, 0, -0.04))

# ---------- dresser ----------
dre = make_coll("Dresser")
dx0, dx1 = 1.75, 2.85
dcx = (dx0 + dx1) / 2
# body
cube("dresser_body", (dcx, 4.26, 0.78), (dx1 - dx0, 0.42, 0.88), teak, dre)
# top drop-front panel (slightly proud)
cube("dresser_dropfront", (dcx, 4.045, 0.98), (dx1 - dx0 - 0.06, 0.025, 0.44), teak, dre)
# two drawer fronts
cube("dresser_drawer1", (dcx, 4.045, 0.66), (dx1 - dx0 - 0.06, 0.025, 0.20), teak, dre)
cube("dresser_drawer2", (dcx, 4.045, 0.44), (dx1 - dx0 - 0.06, 0.025, 0.20), teak, dre)
# brass cup pulls (2 per drawer)
for i, zz in enumerate([0.66, 0.44]):
    for j, xx in enumerate([dcx - 0.28, dcx + 0.28]):
        torus("pull_%d_%d" % (i, j), (xx, 4.035, zz), 0.028, 0.009, brass, dre, rot=(math.pi / 2, 0, 0))
# legs: 4 tapered, slightly splayed
for i, (lx, ly) in enumerate([(dx0 + 0.06, 4.10), (dx1 - 0.06, 4.10), (dx0 + 0.06, 4.42), (dx1 - 0.06, 4.42)]):
    cone("dresser_leg%d" % i, (lx, ly, 0.17), 0.028, 0.018, 0.34, darkwood, dre)

# items on top of dresser
top = make_coll("DresserTop")
# plant pot + snake plant leaves
cube("plant_pot", (2.02, 4.26, 1.34), (0.20, 0.20, 0.24), pot_m, top)
leaf_id = 0
import random
random.seed(7)
for ang in range(0, 360, 40):
    a = math.radians(ang + random.uniform(-12, 12))
    rr = random.uniform(0.0, 0.05)
    h = random.uniform(0.45, 0.85)
    tilt = random.uniform(0.03, 0.22)
    lx = 2.02 + rr * math.cos(a)
    ly = 4.26 + rr * math.sin(a)
    o = cone("leaf%d" % leaf_id, (lx, ly, 1.46 + h / 2), 0.045, 0.006, h, leaf_m, top)
    o.rotation_euler = (tilt * math.cos(a + 1.57), tilt * math.sin(a + 1.57), 0)
    o.scale.y = 0.35
    leaf_id += 1
# framed photo on dresser
cube("photo_frame", (2.38, 4.30, 1.31), (0.16, 0.02, 0.20), darkwood, top, rot=(math.radians(8), 0, 0))
cube("photo_img", (2.38, 4.29, 1.31), (0.12, 0.012, 0.16), cushion_m, top, rot=(math.radians(8), 0, 0))
# table lamp
cone("lamp_base", (2.62, 4.28, 1.36), 0.075, 0.045, 0.26, brass, top)
cyl("lamp_neck", (2.62, 4.28, 1.51), 0.012, 0.08, brass, top)

# ---------- helpers ----------
def make_mat(name, color, rough=0.8, metallic=0.0, emission=None, estr=0.0):
    m = bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    m.use_nodes = True
    b = m.node_tree.nodes['Principled BSDF']
    b.inputs['Base Color'].default_value = (*color, 1.0)
    b.inputs['Roughness'].default_value = rough
    b.inputs['Metallic'].default_value = metallic
    if emission is not None:
        b.inputs['Emission Color'].default_value = (*emission, 1.0)
        b.inputs['Emission Strength'].default_value = estr
    return m

def make_coll(name):
    c = bpy.data.collections.new(name)
    scene.collection.children.link(c)
    return c

def link_to(obj, coll):
    for oc in list(obj.users_collection):
        oc.objects.unlink(obj)
    coll.objects.link(obj)

def finish(obj, name, mat, coll, smooth=False):
    obj.name = name
    if mat:
        obj.data.materials.append(mat)
    if smooth:
        for p in obj.data.polygons:
            p.use_smooth = True
    link_to(obj, coll)
    return obj

    return finish(o, name, mat, coll)

    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(radius=r, depth=depth, location=loc, rotation=rot)
    return finish(bpy.context.active_object, name, mat, coll, smooth)

def cyl_between(name, a, b, r, mat, coll):
    a, b = Vector(a), Vector(b)
    d = b - a
    mid = (a + b) / 2
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(radius=r, depth=d.length, location=mid)
    o = bpy.context.active_object
    o.rotation_mode = 'QUATERNION'

    return finish(o, name, mat, coll, True)

import bpy
import math
import random
from mathutils import Vector

# ---------- scene reset ----------
bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='SELECT')
bpy.ops.object.delete(use_global=False)
for c in list(bpy.data.collections):
    bpy.data.collections.remove(c)

scene = bpy.context.scene
scene.render.engine = 'BLENDER_EEVEE_NEXT'
try:
    scene.eevee.use_raytracing = True
except Exception:
    pass
scene.eevee.taa_render_samples = 32
scene.render.resolution_x = 360
scene.render.resolution_y = 640
scene.render.resolution_percentage = 100
scene.render.fps = 30
scene.frame_start = 1
scene.frame_end = 420
scene.unit_settings.scale_length = 1.0
scene.render.image_settings.file_format = 'PNG'
try:
    scene.view_settings.look = 'AgX - Medium High Contrast'
except Exception:
    pass

# world
world = bpy.data.worlds.new("World")
scene.world = world
world.use_nodes = True
bg = world.node_tree.nodes["Background"]
bg.inputs[0].default_value = (0.085, 0.068, 0.05, 1.0)
bg.inputs[1].default_value = 0.8

CEIL = 3.2

# ---------- helpers ----------
def make_mat(name, color, rough=0.8, metallic=0.0, emission=None, estr=0.0):
    m = bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    m.use_nodes = True
    b = m.node_tree.nodes['Principled BSDF']
    b.inputs['Base Color'].default_value = (*color, 1.0)
    b.inputs['Roughness'].default_value = rough
    b.inputs['Metallic'].default_value = metallic
    if emission is not None:
        b.inputs['Emission Color'].default_value = (*emission, 1.0)
        b.inputs['Emission Strength'].default_value = estr
    return m

def make_coll(name):
    c = bpy.data.collections.new(name)
    scene.collection.children.link(c)
    return c

def link_to(obj, coll):
    for oc in list(obj.users_collection):
        oc.objects.unlink(obj)
    coll.objects.link(obj)

def finish(obj, name, mat, coll, smooth=False):
    obj.name = name
    if mat:
        obj.data.materials.append(mat)
    if smooth:
        for p in obj.data.polygons:
            p.use_smooth = True
    link_to(obj, coll)
    return obj

def cube(name, loc, dims, mat, coll, rot=(0, 0, 0)):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(location=loc, rotation=rot)
    o = bpy.context.active_object
    o.scale = (dims[0] / 2, dims[1] / 2, dims[2] / 2)
    return finish(o, name, mat, coll)

def cyl(name, loc, r, depth, mat, coll, rot=(0, 0, 0), smooth=True):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(radius=r, depth=depth, location=loc, rotation=rot)
    return finish(bpy.context.active_object, name, mat, coll, smooth)

def cyl_between(name, a, b, r, mat, coll):
    a, b = Vector(a), Vector(b)
    d = b - a
    mid = (a + b) / 2
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(radius=r, depth=d.length, location=mid)
    o = bpy.context.active_object
    o.rotation_mode = 'QUATERNION'
    o.rotation_quaternion = d.to_track_quat('Z', 'Y')
    return finish(o, name, mat, coll, True)

def cone(name, loc, r1, r2, depth, mat, coll, rot=(0, 0, 0), smooth=True):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cone_add(radius1=r1, radius2=r2, depth=depth, location=loc, rotation=rot)
    return finish(bpy.context.active_object, name, mat, coll, smooth)

def sphere(name, loc, r, mat, coll):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_uv_sphere_add(radius=r, location=loc, segments=16, ring_count=8)
    return finish(bpy.context.active_object, name, mat, coll, True)

def torus(name, loc, major, minor, mat, coll, rot=(0, 0, 0)):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_torus_add(major_radius=major, minor_radius=minor,
                                     major_segments=28, minor_segments=8,
                                     location=loc, rotation=rot)
    return finish(bpy.context.active_object, name, mat, coll, True)

# ---------- materials ----------
wall_mat   = make_mat("wall_cream", (0.72, 0.66, 0.53), 0.95)
floor_mat  = make_mat("floor_wood", (0.23, 0.11, 0.05), 0.6)
ceil_mat   = make_mat("ceiling", (0.85, 0.84, 0.81), 0.95)
teak       = make_mat("teak", (0.34, 0.15, 0.06), 0.45)
darkwood   = make_mat("darkwood", (0.14, 0.07, 0.035), 0.5)
bedspread  = make_mat("bedspread", (0.62, 0.57, 0.26), 0.95)
mattress_m = make_mat("mattress", (0.86, 0.84, 0.78), 0.95)
pillow_m   = make_mat("pillow_white", (0.88, 0.86, 0.80), 0.95)
cushion_m  = make_mat("cushion_cream", (0.78, 0.70, 0.54), 0.95)
orange     = make_mat("wheel_orange", (0.70, 0.25, 0.06), 0.55)
brass      = make_mat("brass", (0.50, 0.34, 0.12), 0.35, 0.85)
shade_m    = make_mat("lampshade", (0.74, 0.62, 0.45), 0.9)
leaf_m     = make_mat("leaf", (0.12, 0.28, 0.09), 0.65)
pot_m      = make_mat("pot_black", (0.03, 0.03, 0.03), 0.7)
mirror_m   = make_mat("mirror", (0.92, 0.94, 0.96), 0.03, 1.0)
white_m    = make_mat("trim_white", (0.88, 0.85, 0.78), 0.85)
curtain_m  = make_mat("curtain", (0.56, 0.42, 0.26), 0.95)
sill_m     = make_mat("sill", (0.45, 0.20, 0.09), 0.55)
glass_m    = make_mat("glass", (0.75, 0.82, 0.85), 0.08, 0.0)
outside_m  = make_mat("outside_glow", (0.4, 0.55, 0.25), 0.9, 0.0, (0.45, 0.62, 0.30), 2.5)
black_m    = make_mat("frame_black", (0.02, 0.02, 0.02), 0.6)
art_m      = make_mat("art_dark", (0.03, 0.05, 0.04), 0.8)
wicker     = make_mat("wicker", (0.40, 0.26, 0.12), 0.9)
green_m    = make_mat("panel_green", (0.76, 0.78, 0.62), 0.9)
metal_m    = make_mat("conduit", (0.70, 0.70, 0.68), 0.5, 0.6)
tancushion = make_mat("chair_cushion", (0.60, 0.45, 0.26), 0.95)

# ---------- room ----------
room = make_coll("Room")
cube("floor", (2.0, 2.25, -0.05), (4.0, 4.5, 0.1), floor_mat, room)

import bpy
import math
import random
from mathutils import Vector

# ---------- scene reset ----------
bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='SELECT')
bpy.ops.object.delete(use_global=False)
for c in list(bpy.data.collections):
    bpy.data.collections.remove(c)

scene = bpy.context.scene
scene.render.engine = 'BLENDER_EEVEE_NEXT'
try:
    scene.eevee.use_raytracing = True
except Exception:
    pass
scene.eevee.taa_render_samples = 32
scene.render.resolution_x = 360
scene.render.resolution_y = 640
scene.render.resolution_percentage = 100
scene.render.fps = 30
scene.frame_start = 1
scene.frame_end = 420
scene.unit_settings.scale_length = 1.0
scene.render.image_settings.file_format = 'PNG'
try:
    scene.view_settings.look = 'AgX - Medium High Contrast'
except Exception:
    pass

# world
world = bpy.data.worlds.new("World")
scene.world = world
world.use_nodes = True
bg = world.node_tree.nodes["Background"]
bg.inputs[0].default_value = (0.085, 0.068, 0.05, 1.0)
bg.inputs[1].default_value = 0.8

CEIL = 3.2

# ---------- helpers ----------
def make_mat(name, color, rough=0.8, metallic=0.0, emission=None, estr=0.0):
    m = bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    m.use_nodes = True
    b = m.node_tree.nodes['Principled BSDF']
    b.inputs['Base Color'].default_value = (*color, 1.0)
    b.inputs['Roughness'].default_value = rough
    b.inputs['Metallic'].default_value = metallic
    if emission is not None:
        b.inputs['Emission Color'].default_value = (*emission, 1.0)
        b.inputs['Emission Strength'].default_value = estr
    return m

def make_coll(name):
    c = bpy.data.collections.new(name)
    scene.collection.children.link(c)
    return c

def link_to(obj, coll):
    for oc in list(obj.users_collection):
        oc.objects.unlink(obj)
    coll.objects.link(obj)

def finish(obj, name, mat, coll, smooth=False):
    obj.name = name
    if mat:
        obj.data.materials.append(mat)
    if smooth:
        for p in obj.data.polygons:
            p.use_smooth = True
    link_to(obj, coll)
    return obj

def cube(name, loc, dims, mat, coll, rot=(0, 0, 0)):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(location=loc, rotation=rot)
    o = bpy.context.active_object
    o.scale = (dims[0] / 2, dims[1] / 2, dims[2] / 2)
    return finish(o, name, mat, coll)

def cyl(name, loc, r, depth, mat, coll, rot=(0, 0, 0), smooth=True):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(radius=r, depth=depth, location=loc, rotation=rot)
    return finish(bpy.context.active_object, name, mat, coll, smooth)

def cyl_between(name, a, b, r, mat, coll):
    a, b = Vector(a), Vector(b)
    d = b - a
    mid = (a + b) / 2
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(radius=r, depth=d.length, location=mid)
    o = bpy.context.active_object
    o.rotation_mode = 'QUATERNION'
    o.rotation_quaternion = d.to_track_quat('Z', 'Y')
    return finish(o, name, mat, coll, True)

def cone(name, loc, r1, r2, depth, mat, coll, rot=(0, 0, 0), smooth=True):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cone_add(radius1=r1, radius2=r2, depth=depth, location=loc, rotation=rot)
    return finish(bpy.context.active_object, name, mat, coll, smooth)

def sphere(name, loc, r, mat, coll):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_uv_sphere_add(radius=r, location=loc, segments=16, ring_count=8)
    return finish(bpy.context.active_object, name, mat, coll, True)

def torus(name, loc, major, minor, mat, coll, rot=(0, 0, 0)):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_torus_add(major_radius=major, minor_radius=minor,
                                     major_segments=28, minor_segments=8,
                                     location=loc, rotation=rot)
    return finish(bpy.context.active_object, name, mat, coll, True)

pillow_m   = make_mat("pillow_white", (0.88, 0.86, 0.80), 0.95)
cushion_m  = make_mat("cushion_cream", (0.78, 0.70, 0.54), 0.95)

shade_m    = make_mat("lampshade", (0.74, 0.62, 0.45), 0.9)
leaf_m     = make_mat("leaf", (0.12, 0.28, 0.09), 0.65)
pot_m      = make_mat("pot_black", (0.03, 0.03, 0.03), 0.7)
mirror_m   = make_mat("mirror", (0.92, 0.94, 0.96), 0.03, 1.0)
white_m    = make_mat("trim_white", (0.88, 0.85, 0.78), 0.85)
curtain_m  = make_mat("curtain", (0.56, 0.42, 0.26), 0.95)
sill_m     = make_mat("sill", (0.45, 0.20, 0.09), 0.55)
glass_m    = make_mat("glass", (0.75, 0.82, 0.85), 0.08, 0.0)
outside_m  = make_mat("outside_glow", (0.4, 0.55, 0.25), 0.9, 0.0, (0.45, 0.62, 0.30), 2.5)
black_m    = make_mat("frame_black", (0.02, 0.02, 0.02), 0.6)
art_m      = make_mat("art_dark", (0.03, 0.05, 0.04), 0.8)
